mapper.insert: WITH base AS ( SELECT s.id, s.tenant_code, s.agent_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.status, s.csat_score FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.start_time >= #{from} AND s.start_time < #{to} ), msg AS ( SELECT m.session_id, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE m.sender_type = 2) AS agent_msgs, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE m.sender_type = 1) AS customer_msgs FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.send_time >= #{from} AND m.send_time < #{to} GROUP BY m.session_id ), first_agent AS ( SELECT m.session_id, MIN(m.send_time) AS first_at FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.sender_type = 2 AND m.visible_to = 1 GROUP BY m.session_id ), last_customer AS ( SELECT m.session_id, MAX(m.send_time) AS last_at FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.sender_type = 1 GROUP BY m.session_id ), -- 坐席每条消息的"响应间隔"：距它前面最近的一条客户消息 resp AS ( SELECT m.session_id, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.send_time - prev.customer_at))) AS avg_seconds FROM session_message m JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(c.send_time) AS customer_at FROM session_message c WHERE c.tenant_code = m.tenant_code AND c.session_id = m.session_id AND c.sender_type = 1 AND c.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.send_time < m.send_time ) prev ON TRUE WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.sender_type = 2 AND prev.customer_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.session_id ), transfer AS ( SELECT e.session_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM session_event e WHERE e.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND e.event_type = 1 GROUP BY e.session_id ) INSERT INTO agent_daily_metric (id, tenant_code, agent_id, agent_name, stat_date, session_count, human_session_count, message_count, customer_message_count, first_response_seconds, avg_response_seconds, avg_session_seconds, transfer_count, csat_count, csat_score, good_csat_count, close_count, create_time, update_time) SELECT -- 主键：坐席 + 租户 + 日期 的 64 位哈希。 -- 为什么不用"agent_id 乘个系数再加日期"：雪花 ID 本身就是 19 位，乘完直接 bigint out of range -- （踩过）。哈希同样稳定（重算同一 坐席×天 命中同一主键），又不会溢出。 hashtextextended(#{tenantCode} || ':' || COALESCE(b.agent_id, 0)::text || ':' || #{statDate}, 0) AS id, #{tenantCode}, -- 未分配 / 机器人接待统一落 0：UNIQUE 约束对 NULL 不生效，留 NULL 会重复插行 COALESCE(b.agent_id, 0) AS agent_id, NULL AS agent_name, #{statDate}, COUNT(1) AS session_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE b.agent_id IS NOT NULL) AS human_session_count, COALESCE(SUM(msg.agent_msgs), 0) AS message_count, COALESCE(SUM(msg.customer_msgs), 0) AS customer_message_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fa.first_at - lc.last_at))))::INT, 0) AS first_response_seconds, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(resp.avg_seconds))::INT, 0) AS avg_response_seconds, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(b.end_time, now()) - b.start_time))))::INT, 0) AS avg_session_seconds, COALESCE(SUM(tr.cnt), 0) AS transfer_count, COUNT(b.csat_score) AS csat_count, ROUND(AVG(b.csat_score)::numeric, 2) AS csat_score, COUNT(b.csat_score) FILTER (WHERE b.csat_score >= 4) AS good_csat_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 4) AS close_count, now(), now() FROM base b LEFT JOIN msg ON msg.session_id = b.id LEFT JOIN first_agent fa ON fa.session_id = b.id LEFT JOIN last_customer lc ON lc.session_id = b.id LEFT JOIN resp ON resp.session_id = b.id LEFT JOIN transfer tr ON tr.session_id = b.id GROUP BY COALESCE(b.agent_id, 0) ON CONFLICT (tenant_code, agent_id, stat_date) DO UPDATE SET session_count = EXCLUDED.session_count, human_session_count = EXCLUDED.human_session_count, message_count = EXCLUDED.message_count, customer_message_count = EXCLUDED.customer_message_count, first_response_seconds = EXCLUDED.first_response_seconds, avg_response_seconds = EXCLUDED.avg_response_seconds, avg_session_seconds = EXCLUDED.avg_session_seconds, transfer_count = EXCLUDED.transfer_count, csat_count = EXCLUDED.csat_count, csat_score = EXCLUDED.csat_score, good_csat_count = EXCLUDED.good_csat_count, close_count = EXCLUDED.close_count, update_time = now()
mapper.sql: COALESCE(m.agent_id, 0) AS agent_id, COALESCE(MAX(m.agent_name), '未分配 / 机器人接待') AS agent_name, SUM(m.session_count) AS session_count, SUM(m.human_session_count) AS human_session_count, SUM(m.message_count) AS message_count, SUM(m.customer_message_count) AS customer_message_count, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(m.first_response_seconds, 0)))::INT AS first_response_seconds, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(m.avg_response_seconds, 0)))::INT AS avg_response_seconds, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(m.avg_session_seconds, 0)))::INT AS avg_session_seconds, SUM(m.transfer_count) AS transfer_count, SUM(m.csat_count) AS csat_count, ROUND(AVG(m.csat_score)::numeric, 2) AS csat_score, SUM(m.good_csat_count) AS good_csat_count, SUM(m.close_count) AS close_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.stat_date) AS active_days
mapper.select: SELECT m.stat_date AS stat_date, SUM(m.session_count) AS session_count, SUM(m.message_count) AS message_count, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(m.first_response_seconds, 0)))::INT AS first_response_seconds, ROUND(AVG(m.csat_score)::numeric, 2) AS csat_score FROM agent_daily_metric m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND COALESCE(m.agent_id, 0) = COALESCE(#{agentId}, 0) AND m.stat_date >= #{from} AND m.stat_date <= #{to} GROUP BY m.stat_date ORDER BY m.stat_date

SELECT m.stat_date AS stat_date, SUM(m.session_count) AS session_count, -- 机器人接待 = 当天总接待 - 人工接手过的（与今日口径一致） SUM(m.session_count - m.human_session_count) AS bot_count, SUM(m.message_count) AS message_count, SUM(m.csat_count) AS csat_count, SUM(m.good_csat_count) AS good_csat_count, ROUND(AVG(m.csat_score)::numeric, 2) AS csat_score, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(m.first_response_seconds, 0)))::INT AS first_response_seconds FROM agent_daily_metric m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.stat_date >= #{from} AND m.stat_date <= #{to} GROUP BY m.stat_date ORDER BY m.stat_date
